name: player_solve_height_on_surface
description: Player::SolveHeightOnSurface solves the player's Y coordinate from a support-plane dot product and the current steering reference normal.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the Player environment-probe surface-fit pass so x87 division and caller inlining context can be compared together.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x42cde0 validates the plane-height solve using world X/Z, steerBasisRef X/Y/Z, supportPlaneDot, and the 0.0001 Y-normal fallback when the Y component is zero.
The native smoke verifies the normal solve and the zero-Y fallback behavior used by probe surface reconstruction callers.
